title: Battle of Purandar
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Purandar", at revision 1370586809, opens: "The Battle of Purandar was fought between the Mughal Empire and the Marathas in 1665." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q19882272, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "The Battle of Purandar was fight twice leaded by Baji Pasalkar and Murarbaji Deshpande.". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
